name: PyVista Point Cloud Processing
description: Point cloud and mesh filtering operations via PyVista: thresholding, clipping by plane/box, random sampling, and scalar-based point extraction.

videos.title: Point Cloud Processing with Open3D (Loading, Visualizing, Sampling)
3D Mesh, Point Cloud & Volume Processing with Open3D

theory.overview:
PyVista provides spatial and scalar filtering for point data:

**Threshold** keeps points/cells within a scalar range.
**Clip** removes geometry on one side of a plane.
**Clip Box** crops to a bounding box.
**Random Sampling** reduces data by random selection.
**Extract Points** selects points matching scalar criteria.

pv_threshold.title: Scalar Threshold
pv_threshold.content: Keeps cells whose scalar values satisfy $l \leq s_i \leq u$ for lower bound $l$ and upper bound $u$.

pv_clip_plane.title: Clip by Plane
pv_clip_plane.content: Removes all geometry on the negative side of the plane $\mathbf{n} \cdot (\mathbf{x} - \mathbf{o}) = 0$.

pv_clip_box.title: Clip by Box
pv_clip_box.content: Keeps geometry inside the axis-aligned box $[x_{min}, x_{max}] \times [y_{min}, y_{max}] \times [z_{min}, z_{max}]$.

pv_random_sample.title: Random Sampling
pv_random_sample.content: Uniformly samples a fraction $f$ of the input points without replacement.

pv_extract_points.title: Extract Points by Scalar
pv_extract_points.content: Selects points whose scalar values lie within a specified range, producing a filtered point cloud.

parameters.name: invert
parameters.description: Invert the threshold (keep values OUTSIDE the range).

parameters.name: continuous
parameters.description: Use continuous cell range: include cells whose scalar range overlaps [lower, upper].

parameters.name: preference
parameters.description: Whether to threshold on cell or point scalars when both exist.

parameters.name: all_scalars
parameters.description: Require all points of a cell to satisfy the criterion (else any point).

parameters.name: component_mode
parameters.description: For multi-component scalars: test all components, any component, or a single one.

parameters.name: component
parameters.description: Component index to threshold when component_mode='component'.

parameters.name: invert
parameters.description: Which side to keep. True (default) keeps the side the normal points away from.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Scalar offset of the clip plane along the normal.

parameters.name: crinkle
parameters.description: Keep whole cells crossed by the plane instead of cutting them (crinkle clip).

parameters.name: invert
parameters.description: Invert the box selection (keep geometry OUTSIDE the box).

parameters.name: merge_points
parameters.description: Merge coincident points in the clipped output.

parameters.name: crinkle
parameters.description: Keep whole cells crossed by the box instead of cutting them (crinkle clip).

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: RNG seed for reproducibility; -1 = no seeding (non-deterministic, original behavior).

parameters.name: adjacent_cells
parameters.description: Include cells that contain at least one selected point (else only fully-selected cells).

parameters.name: include_cells
parameters.description: Carry cells through to the output (else points only).
